purpose: We are preparing a policy briefing on respiratory medicines supply for the health planning committee of an Austrian federal state. The briefing needs inhaler use among adults with asthma in fine age bands.
question: How often are combined inhalers and anticholinergic inhalers used for asthma in different age groups?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Combined inhaler = ATC code starting with R03AK; Anticholinergic inhaler = ATC code starting with R03BB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: adults with asthma, % with an active combined inhaler, % with an active anticholinergic inhaler, one decimal.

expected.reason: The stated purpose fits only public health, policy-making or official statistics (Art. 53(1), points (a) to (c)). Access for those purposes is reserved for public sector bodies and Union bodies (Art. 53(2)); the applicant is not one, so no allowed purpose remains and access is refused (Art. 53). A refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)); a reframed application under another purpose may be submitted.

judge.why: Rule 2: a private consultancy whose purpose is only a policy briefing for a health planning committee fits policy-making alone, with nothing readable as research, teaching, care improvement or algorithm work, so Art. 53(2) bars it.

review: Blind review 2026-10-30: the applicant processes on behalf of a public body, which Art. 53(2) covers ('including where processing ... is done by a third party on behalf of those public sector bodies'); REJECT [53] is contestable, human call needed
